speaker: Doctor
text:
Does the swelling appear to be localized to a specific joint, or is it diffuse along the entire length of the finger?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Progressive swelling and pain in the right ring finger. I also have Inability to flex the right ring finger at the distal interphalangeal joint when making a fist, Pain at the distal interphalangeal joint, Extended right ring finger in resting position.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the mechanism of injury and your inability to flex the distal joint, I suspect a flexor tendon avulsion. REQUEST TEST: X-Ray of right hand.
